protocol.train: September 2026 only; labels on real tick paths
protocol.query: First observed quote at least 5s after preceding observation; past tick windows and completed-M1 context only; 08:00–15:55 UTC
protocol.entry: Higher predicted long/short net R >0.10 and >opposite+0.05; no quota
protocol.guards: Observed gap warmup, volatility-shock cooldown and spread spikes; execution stop/cost/margin/volume checks; 15% daily / 60% peak experimental account limits, no default changes
limitations: New features/objective frozen before October results; October has already been used in prior research, not pristine market data.
Independent native execution screen, not broker-native certification or integrated local runtime profitability.
Training labels use observed bid/ask barriers or timeout, 200ms delay, adverse rounding/slippage and fees; no future labels calculated for October.
All quotes are reference Exness data; no historical news calendar, partial-fill or financing qualification. No annualization.

source_manifests.volumeMeaning: Observed quote count, not traded volume
limitations: Exness Raw Spread reference; not JustMarkets or a prop firm fill record
No invented quotes, spreads or weekend bars
Commission, latency, fill reserve and lot/margin rules are scenarios
